full_judgment: 17. In support of this contention Mr. Shamsul Karim has referred to the case of Ghulam vs. Crown reported in PLD 1950 (Lah) 90. In this case the offence committed by the appellant amounted to murder under section 302 of the Penal Code. In this case the appellant engaged in a quarrel with his wife, suddenly picked up a hatchet with which he struck her on the head and the woman died within a few minutes. The post-mortem examination found the skull fractured into twelve pieces. In the instant case before us there was only one fracture and not as many as 12 pieces. The decision cited by the learned Advocate for the petitioner has no manner of application to the facts of the present case.
